description:
Ride in style on the 20-inch Durango Racer MTB-style bike. Featuring bold colors and cool specs, the Durango Racer has what you need for a great ride. The simplicity of a single speed MTB-style bike will help your little rider graduate from a sidewalk bike to larger bikes. The durable steel frame features front and rear handbrakes for solid control. This MTB-style bike includes an alloy quick release and padded saddle to adjust the seat height for the right fit. A fun ride that will help your child love to ride bikes!Manufacturer may substitute components with components of equal or greater performance level.

Features:

Youth bike designed to help kids graduate from a sidewalk bike

Front caliper hand brake for safety and learning proper riding technique

Single speed hub with coaster brake that allows your child to focus on riding and braking

Rigid steel frame and fork offer a simple and durable bike

Adjustable seat height allows the bike to grow with your child

20” wheels made for riding on trails and around the neighborhood

Ideal for riders 5-9 years old
